details.direction: Point-to-point from Miller Street, North Sydney, to the Sydney Opera House
details.distanceMethod: Official 42.195 km from the 2026 course page. The World Athletics results page lists the men's and women's marathon, and no competing official distance figure was found.
details.elevationMethod: 2026 course page re-checked 2026-11-20: +317 m gain, −400 m loss and −83 m net. An older 2026-11-06 record of the same page gave +313 / −396 / −83; the 2027 page shows +313 / −83. The 4 m difference is not explained by the organiser, so this entity uses the current 2026 page figure and keeps the older record on the route page.
details.attribution: TCS Sydney Marathon 2026 course page links a GPX file at the official-domain Wix host. The file is GPX 1.1, creator Garmin Connect, 650 trkpt / 650 ele / 0 wpt; its internal name still says 'TCS Sydney Marathon 2025 - 42.195 km', its metadata link points to goandrace.com, and its metadata time is 2026-08-03T10:03:42. Haversine sum 42.2424 km (47.4 m longer than 42.195 km); raw elevation +283 / −357 m, not the official +313/−396 or +317/−400. No copyright line or redistribution licence; the site links only and does not host, draw or bundle the track.
